Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/parameters

src/agent_runtime/parameters/init.py

Python · Tier A

Local Agent Parameter Store subsystem.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding.py

Python · Tier A

Resolve task-owned accepted parameters into exact tool arguments and Shell/Python inputs. Source reads, structure/field pages and bounded correction actions share JSON Pointer rules; generic bindings reject conflicting destinations and preserve accepted revisions. This module performs no store lookup, model call, interpolation or execution. Callers validate the resolved tool schema and authorize the concrete arguments; optional model projections do not alter executor data.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ParameterBindingError 50 A value-free binding failure, always before execution.
setting_mode 68 Read the one global preference at admission, including embedded runtimes.
mode 77 Historical snapshots remain literal; current snapshots must declare their mode.
shape 90 Describe arbitrary JSON without publishing its scalar values.
manifest 107 Produce the same structure-only view for every model-context consumer.
accepted 114 Resolve a canonical accepted key, without aliases or current-store fallback.
value_at 129 Read one exact accepted Value JSON pointer, returning a detached subtree and its owning binding. Invalid or overlong pointers produce bounded valid-ancestor recovery facts, never a guessed replacement.
read 150 Serve value, recursive structure or a paged list of absolute field addresses. Value reads project the whole source tree before selecting a subtree so credential provenance survives; only fields accepts integer offset/limit (1–64).
pointer_tokens 211 Validate a nonempty destination pointer within 1,024 characters and decode only JSON Pointer escapes. This describes tool-argument placement, not a parameter lookup or filesystem path.
resolve_arguments 222 Resolve 1–32 exact declarations into a deep copy. Destination parents must exist; object leaves must be absent and array leaves existing null slots. Reject overlaps and runtime routing/control destinations, then return arguments plus accepted revision provenance.
execution_inputs 283 Copy the complete accepted namespace into code inputs only in bound mode. Unresolved references or a caller-supplied case-insensitive PARAMETERS key fail; literal mode and empty snapshots preserve ordinary input semantics.
prepare_inputs 303 Prepare code inputs before authorization; a process-local mark prevents reinjection.
provenance 321 Accepted revisions identify inputs without publishing values or value hashes.
input_authority 334 Replace any previous parameter_input_sources with this snapshot’s key/revision pairs. Operation identity can include accepted inputs without copying their values or computing secret-derived hashes.
preview_arguments 342 Keep runtime-supplied payloads out of call summaries independently of redaction.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_approvals.py

Python · Tier A

Persist approval evidence and the generation boundary for newly accepted tasks. Equivalent reusable rules share an identity; a new rule advances the authority’s approval generation once. The rule, generation marker and approval receipt/history commit together in Controller RAM or standalone SQLite. Accepted task snapshots retain their earlier generation through edits and continuation. Idempotent retries must carry the same request hash; changed reviewed revisions fail as conflicts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
generation 23 Read the current approval generation from the mapping authority, defaulting to zero before any review rule is created.
active 29 Check a rule’s approval generation against the task’s accepted boundary. Legacy correction rules default to generation zero; a missing task watermark cannot acquire later review rules.
retain_boundary 38 Carry the previous task’s approval generation into replacement accepted inputs. Editing intent or parameters does not promote an existing task to newly approved review rules.
fingerprint 49 Hash the executable matching definition and target-sorted bindings. Title, enabled state and descriptive metadata do not define equivalence; source identities, scope, contract and reviewed connection do.
identical 61 Find an equivalent reusable rule, excluding run-limited and one-time definitions. This comparison does not enable a disabled rule or advance its generation.
approve 76 Commit deduplication, revision recheck, optional generation/rule creation and approval evidence in one authority transaction. Use RAM atomic records or SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE with immutable history; an exception leaves the transaction uncommitted.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_evidence.py

Python · Tier A

Normalize recorded binding provenance for one concrete invocation. Direct calls retain their recorded links. Supported composite calls strip the selected activity/step/item destination prefix, preserving sequence-wide cwd and timeout links where implemented. This adapter copies evidence and returns None when it cannot establish the requested concrete relationship; it never discovers bindings by comparing parameter values to tool arguments.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
concrete 18 Copy provenance, retain already-concrete or matching direct-call records, otherwise select links under the supplied composite child index. Normalize supported pointer prefixes and sequence-wide fields; unsupported parent shapes or missing child identity return None.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/binding_reviews.py

Python · Tier A

Review successful invocation evidence and save reusable bindings for future tasks. BindingReviews joins the selected run, exact settled receipt, accepted parameter snapshot and current tool contract. Public projections mask literals; stateless previews bind source choices to evidence and saved revisions. Explicit approval revalidates under the queue lock and commits through binding_approvals. No method pauses, resumes, steers or dispatches the reviewed task. Conflicts require another inspection or preview instead of silently refreshing the accepted source values.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
BindingReviews 50 Own read-only evidence reconstruction and save-only approval for one API context. Native run storage supplies receipts; Parameter Store supplies versioned mapping documents; the update broker announces acknowledged approval.
BindingReviews.run 62 Load the selected run without mutation, verify request ownership through current/resume/resolved identity, and require bound mode in its accepted snapshot. Reject foreign, unavailable or reference-only tasks.
BindingReviews.exact_receipt 77 Read only this run and invocation’s settled artifact from RAM or standalone SQL, falling back to its recorded invocation result if no artifact row exists. Do not follow inherited result links into another run.
BindingReviews.context 95 Reconstruct one eligible call from a complete successful receipt, current contract and accepted snapshot. Verify previously learned source revisions or explicit recorded field provenance, including concrete composite children and exact value/type agreement. Build/check the reusable rule and evidence digest; absent history, changed contracts or unreconstructable relationships fail closed.
BindingReviews.public 233 Project identities, scope, recorded mappings, saved revision and separate execution/user- assessment state. Detailed inspection additionally supplies masked argument structure and source/destination catalogs; accepted scalar values are not copied into the response.
BindingReviews.candidates 274 Page newest-first scalar invocation metadata before loading evidence bodies. Skip unavailable candidates, preserve invocation-order cursors as new calls arrive and stop at the requested number of eligible rows. Return the explanation and a cursor without mutating task state.
BindingReviews.inspect 304 Reconstruct one selected invocation and return its detailed public projection; eligibility and ownership errors propagate through the route’s conflict response.
BindingReviews.preview 311 Recheck observed/saved revisions, resolve explicit source IDs only from the invocation’s accepted catalog, and validate the proposed rule and materialized schema. Return a masked preview, exact token, rule and value-free approval evidence. Edits are marked unexecuted; prior-result mappings are redirected to library management.
BindingReviews.approve 392 Return an identical prior idempotent approval or re-preview under the task-queue lock, compare the token and commit via the authority transaction. Publish parameters.changed after success. Changed intent/evidence is rejected; no current task mutation or dispatch occurs.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/context.py

Python · Tier A

Locate the existing Parameter Store in a context mapping for skill adapters. Prefer an outer supported store, then its nested execution_context; accept both standalone and hub implementations. This lookup neither opens storage nor creates an independent repository, preserving the Controller’s shared authority.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/corrections.py

Python · Tier A

Own explicit user correction sessions and recoverable application of a reviewed rule. Inspection and preview are passive. Explicit call/task entry requests cooperative Pause through the existing control owner; selecting a call can retry that request. Application freezes accepted inputs, journals the intended rule, saves a mapping, records a structured amendment when needed and resumes through native controls. It never dispatches a tool: the Agent chooses its next operation. Terminal calls, later successful retries and unknown outcomes use future-only saving. Session revisions, idempotency receipts and pause stamps guard retries and ownership.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Corrections 47 Coordinate one correction lifecycle using context-owned runs, parameter documents and injected native control. Keep inspection, user intent, authority writes and execution ownership separate.
Corrections.notify 58 Announce parameter/run/task changes after an explicit mutation, optionally including the session’s request identity for targeted refresh.
Corrections.call 68 Resolve the current request attempt, enforce any expected run identity and accepted bound mode, then load the exact invocation and concrete tool contract. Reject stale attempts, missing calls and aggregate/unavailable capabilities.
Corrections.eligibility 92 Return passive eligibility plus invocation/evidence identities for an explicit later correction request. Reading this projection does not pause or mutate work.
Corrections.pause_stamp 105 Read the existing manual-pause timestamp or pending pause marker from the selected authority. Sessions use this identity to avoid releasing a different pause.
Corrections.create 117 Under the queue lock, reuse an idempotent or same-call active session, select into an existing task picker, or create one session after checking invocation/rule revisions. Request cooperative Pause explicitly and return inspection; a different open correction for the run blocks another session.
Corrections.request_pause 177 Leave terminal/already-paused work alone and avoid repeating the same recorded pending request. Otherwise call native Pause and persist its stamp, claiming ownership only when this session initiated the request; interruption can retry the explicit request path.
Corrections.session 200 Load a current session document by identity and reject absent or differently typed records.
Corrections.start_task 208 Delegate persistent task-card entry to task_corrections, sharing the same durable session and pause ownership as per-call entry.
Corrections.select_call 215 Delegate exact invocation selection and revision checking for an existing task picker; selection does not authorize Apply before accepted work settles.
Corrections.ready 223 Treat terminal work as save-only ready; otherwise require paused state, no pending/unsettled work, no run lease owner and no running trace. This fences a worker still publishing its final paused checkpoint.
Corrections.context 240 Reconstruct the original proposal and accepted inputs, preferring any frozen correction snapshot. Explicit refresh keys can add current saved values before freezing. Collect earlier owned receipts, target scope and later exact successful retries; derive readiness and save-only mode for terminal, recovered-success or unknown outcomes.
Corrections.inspect 341 Return a masked picker or mapping projection with revision, readiness, source/destination catalogs, scope and recovery intent. Recognize a frozen application even if the session journal still appears open. Current saved parameter metadata supports an explicit refresh choice; inspection itself does not accept new inputs.
Corrections.masked_arguments 408 Recursively retain object/list structure while replacing every scalar with a mask for UI inspection. The separate audited reveal endpoint owns disclosure of current saved values.
Corrections.preview 426 Require the current open session revision, resolve chosen source IDs and materialize/schema-check a reviewed rule. Detect later matching successful execution, reject one-time intent when only future saving is possible, and hash rule/source/evidence/save-only state into a token without applying it.
Corrections.check_template 514 Reject remembered templates that retain protected accepted values, literal credential fields or sshpass -p. For python.transform, exclude only the literal identity key of an actual inputs.parameters lookup from the protected-value comparison; do not exempt other code or comments.
Corrections.apply 611 Under the queue lock, resume identical journaled intent or re-preview and freeze a new application. Persist the applying session and rule, then an explicit selection and idempotent amendment when retry is allowed; otherwise release only an owned pause. Mark applied last. Each durable stage can be retried; this is not one transaction and it dispatches no tool.
Corrections.accept_snapshot 753 Claim a maintenance lease and freeze the reviewed parameter snapshot plus apply intent inside the paused/terminal native task. Reject conflicting accepted intent and always release the lease; a later retry cannot silently refresh saved credentials.
Corrections.release_pause 786 Resume only a paused task whose current pause stamp matches the session’s stamp. If cooperative pause is still pending, reject cancellation until settlement; a different completed pause is left alone.
Corrections.cancel 799 Replay an identical cancellation or require the current open session revision. Release a pause only when the session owns it, then persist cancelled status and announce the change; an applying correction must be recovered rather than discarded.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/defaults.py

Python · Tier A

Build fresh nonsecret default records for run temporary, final artifact and activity temporary directories. Values store environment-variable names and Gateway-execution guidance rather than paths captured on the Controller. Store initialization seeds only missing canonical keys, retaining user edits; this module does not create directories or read host environment values.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
default_parameters 11 Return fresh, non-secret parameter drafts without capturing any local paths.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/diagnostics.py

Python · Tier A

Turn parameter-resolution failures into typed value-free facts and bounded runtime explanations. Strict models allow canonical names, size counts and enumerated storage causes; machine error codes distinguish busy/permission/full/corrupt/I/O failures without parsing arbitrary exception text. Recovery of old held tasks recognizes exact historical templates only. Admission and runtime-message callers own persistence and retry.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ExpansionSize 22 Admit only a canonical-looking parameter name and nonnegative character count for size diagnostics; reject unknown fields and coercible nonmatching types.
ResolutionDiagnostic 28 Only identities, counts and enumerated causes may enter a Runtime message.
ResolutionDiagnostic.notice 55 Render the allowlisted cause into the existing runtime message and recovery guidance. Oversize notices include aggregate counts and at most five largest entries; storage details use enumerated causes, never exception text.
storage_reason 166 Classify machine error codes; exception messages may contain credentials.
saved_diagnostic 193 Rebuild public copy from typed facts, including pre-diagnostic held tasks. Historical free-form errors are never printed. Only exact known templates are recognized; an unrecognized error asks the user to recheck.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/drafting.py

Python · Tier A

Prepare editable Parameter Store drafts from user text without saving records. A supplied model client can classify and extract structured drafts; validation/model failures fall back to deterministic JSON, pasted-field, connection and credential heuristics. Normalizers retain explicit user data, repair field-label misreads and mark missing information. The caller owns model routing, user review and CRUD; sealed prompt text and response schemas remain runtime contracts.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
looks_like_parameter_store_request 129 Return whether the prompt appears to ask for a parameter-store set draft.
_key_from_prompt 198 Try explicit key/name/domain phrases before limited DICOM, Git SSH and database heuristics. Return a normalized candidate or empty string rather than saving an inferred identity.
_parse_scalar_value 242 Interpret quoted strings, Booleans, null, decimal numbers and complete JSON containers as draft data. Unrecognized or malformed text stays literal; no expressions or commands are evaluated.
_inline_key_value_pairs 303 Extract at least two inline key/value spans, ignoring URI scheme prefixes and invalid field labels. Parse each bounded span as scalar draft data, with later repeated keys replacing earlier values.
_heuristic_draft 475 For write-intent requests, try whole JSON, pasted fields, URI/host details and credential phrases in that order. Return one editable create draft with confidence and missing details; weak evidence produces an incomplete draft, never a store mutation.
llm_parameter_draft_response 714 Call the supplied complete_json client once under a fresh parameter prompt-cache scope. Validate the response envelope, accepting a single-draft compatibility shape, then normalize; unavailable clients and invalid data raise to the caller.
llm_parameter_draft 738 Ask an LLM client for one structured parameter-store draft.
_normalize_llm_draft 754 Normalize identity and metadata, repair impossible model connection fields using explicit pasted values, maintain missing-detail flags and promote sensitivity when field names indicate secrets. Return None only when both identity and value remain absent.
draft_parameter_from_prompt 803 Validate input, try model drafting only when enabled with a client and store-related text, and fall back after model errors. The fallback recognizes write intent only; neither path saves, deletes or connects anything.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/email_templates.py

Python · Tier A

Provide detached SMTP OAuth setup presets using the existing Auth profile types.

Responsibilities

Pair provider-specific client/connection drafts with SMTP scopes.

Boundaries

No separate Email token store, automatic save, consent or network work.

Lifecycle

Parameter Store copies these incomplete drafts before the user edits and saves.

State

Source-owned constants only; saved client/connection records own all secrets.

Security

Fixed SMTP scopes; Microsoft app-only permissions remain administrator-owned.

Collaborators

auth/profiles.py validates OAuth; parameters/templates.py presents drafts.

Public surface

OAUTH_TEMPLATES supplies stable IDs, labels, guidance and detached values.

@see src/agent_runtime/auth/profiles.py

src/agent_runtime/parameters/fields.py

Python · Tier A

Generate value-free absolute JSON addresses for parameter manifests, paged reads and recovery from invalid pointers. Deterministic traversal preserves object/array types, caps callable pointers at 1,024 characters and marks deeper descendants. Manifest allocation retains metadata and whole entries within one shared character budget; it rejects an oversized minimum instead of truncating JSON. Binding and reference modules consume these pure helpers.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
serialized 23 Serialize complete prompt entries with sorted keys, compact separators and unescaped Unicode so allocation uses the same character count as the emitted description.
value_type 29 Name the JSON type without returning a scalar value, distinguishing Boolean from integer despite Python’s shared numeric ancestry.
children 47 Yield immediate child values with escaped absolute JSON Pointers, sorting object keys and preserving array order; scalars have no children.
entries 58 Preorder traversal, including containers and only callable addresses. A too-long address cannot have addressable descendants. Mark its nearest callable parent; callers can bind that complete value or use code inputs.
action 79 Construct an explicit read_parameter fields-page request with its canonical key, subtree pointer, offset and limit; constructing the action does not execute it.
correction 92 Find the deepest valid ancestor, never a guessed replacement field.
prompt_limit 120 The existing installation limit, supplied by native initialization.
describe 128 Retain context/description/aliases/tags and revision while allocating whole field entries within one aggregate prompt limit. Start with each record’s smaller complete/root representation, then expand round-robin; reject even the minimum when it cannot fit.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/learned_workflows.py

Python · Tier A

Teach reviewed ordered call sequences and launch them through ordinary tasks. Preview captures selected successful invocations, exact mapping revisions and source identities, assigning explicit predecessor and producer dependencies. Templates omit mapped values; future runs resolve accepted parameters and fresh current-run receipts through existing native workflow guards. Launch records, conversation identity and task lookup make interrupted creation recoverable. This feature is separate from saved-request Workflows; the Agent still issues each reviewed step and the normal admission/execution owners enforce it.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
calls 34 List settled run receipts with operation order, success and any accepted mapping identity for the teaching picker. This is a discovery projection, not workflow validation or execution.
preview 61 Validate one to 64 distinct selected successful calls, recover exact reviewed mappings and require result producers earlier in the selected order. Build protected-value-checked templates and explicit step dependencies under one workspace/Gateway scope; return the recorded workflow artifact and token without saving or dispatching.
run 197 Require EULA acceptance, current enabled workflow revision and bound parameter mode. Under the queue lock, recover/create the idempotent launch record, dedicated conversation and ordinary queued task using current defaults in the original scope. Persist task identity before queueing; a repeated launch key reuses the task.
step_rule 302 Copy the step’s reviewed mapping and bind each declared producer_step to this run’s completed claimed operation. Reject missing/incomplete producer ownership so downstream materialization cannot reuse an older run’s output.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/mapping_store.py

Python · Tier A

Store versioned mapping definitions and their user-owned lifecycle documents. MappingStore uses the Parameter Store’s Controller RAM records when available, otherwise its standalone SQLite connection. Current documents and immutable revisions change together under compare-and-set and idempotency checks. Reads return detached payloads. Feedback records user assessment separately from tool settlement and can suspend the used rule revision; this layer never executes work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
MappingConflict 26 The displayed document or idempotency identity is no longer current.
initialize 33 Create the standalone mapping document/history tables and kind index if absent. Called by database initialization; Controller runtime authority uses its registered record tables instead.
MappingStore 49 Provide the same revisioned document operations over RAM authority and standalone SQLite, sharing Parameter Store ownership rather than creating a separate execution service.
MappingStore.get 57 Return one detached current document or None through a RAM view or SQL read, decoding the stored payload without changing revisions.
MappingStore.list 67 Read detached documents of one kind and sort by update time then identity for deterministic library/session presentation.
MappingStore.history 83 Return immutable payload revisions in ascending revision order from the selected authority.
MappingStore.put 99 Hash caller content without repository metadata, replay an identical application identity, or compare the expected revision before stamping a new document. Atomically publish current and history rows; mismatched identity content or stale revision raises MappingConflict.
MappingStore.feedback 177 Save an application verdict with revision checks. An incorrect verdict records suspension of the exact used rule revision and disables an enabled current rule only when its reviewed definition still matches. These are successive repository writes, not one combined feedback transaction.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/mappings.py

Python · Tier A

Describe and materialize exact user-reviewed argument mappings. Rules bind source identities and pointers to destinations under a tool contract and workspace/Gateway scope. Helpers build value-free source catalogs, structural templates and bounded SSH connection selectors; materialization reads accepted parameter snapshots or unambiguous fresh receipts. Only reviewed destinations are overwritten. This module neither selects work for the model nor dispatches it; invalid identities, pointers, types and protected destinations reject the mapping.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
digest 29 Hash a sorted-key Unicode JSON representation for stable source, template and approval identities. Inputs must remain JSON-serializable; this is an identity digest, not an encryption layer.
scope 37 Project the accepted execution/workspace root and Gateway identity, using execution configuration and controller defaults only when context fields are absent.
successful 51 Require executed success/completion, complete available results and a zero process exit when present. Missing optional completeness/availability/exit fields use compatibility defaults; review eligibility can impose stricter checks.
owned_receipts 66 Read settled receipts for this run and attach each invocation’s accepted target scope, combining its pending target with the run’s resume context. Do not follow result links to another run.
source_catalog 83 Describe up to 1024 source pointers/types from accepted parameter records and eligible earlier receipt data. Include stable parameter creation identity or exact producer identity/digest/scope, with hashed selection IDs; never include scalar values in catalog entries.
resolve_source 136 Resolve a parameter only if its accepted creation identity still matches, or select one successful current receipt by exact same-run operation or reviewed producer digest/scope. Copy the pointed value, enforce its recorded type and return provenance revision; ambiguity or missing fields rejects reuse.
runtime_destination 185 Identify top-level routing/internal controls and the reserved inputs.parameters subtree that user mappings cannot replace.
replace 196 Write a copied value through a validated destination pointer, creating missing dictionary parents while requiring existing list positions. Reject runtime-owned destinations and incompatible/missing parent containers.
skeleton 219 Copy arguments and replace reviewed destinations with source-identity markers. The result captures unchanged argument structure for deterministic matching without storing mapped values.
destinations 229 Describe schema properties recursively, excluding runtime-owned controls, then add bounded concrete argument paths absent from that schema list. Supply pointers and types for editor selection; server rule/schema checks remain authoritative.
connection_alias 260 Return the rule-specific .invalid symbolic host used in model-facing SSH examples; native preparation must resolve it to the reviewed connection before execution.
connection_identity 266 Hash executable, host, username and normalized port. Password and remote-command text do not select a connection, permitting reviewed connection reuse for another remote operation.
build_rule 279 Validate one to 32 distinct destinations and construct either a non-overlapping argument skeleton or bounded SSH-role template. SSH requires a host binding and a password source for password authentication; preserve scope, contract and optional run restriction for later matching.
applicable 342 Check enabled state, capability, scope, run restriction and accepted parameter keys, then match the reviewed argument skeleton or SSH connection identity/explicit alias. Matching does not choose between multiple rules, resolve private execution values or guarantee contract compatibility.
materialize 388 Copy a proposed call, resolve each reviewed source and collect exact revision provenance. Replace structured destinations or render the bounded SSH command with a separate private environment; return arguments/environment/provenance without dispatching anything.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Own live Parameter Store values, revisions, search indexes and audits in the Controller hub. Atomic mutations enforce identity/dependency checks and publish detached models; usage accounting leaves configuration timestamps unchanged. Legacy value-search and exact metadata suggestions remain separate paths. Recovery/checkpoint schemas retain plaintext private data, while consumer/audit projection follows Auth privacy and configured redaction. The factory in store.py selects this repository and forbids direct runtime SQL.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
matcher 47 Reproduce legacy SQLite substring matching, including percent/underscore wildcards, ASCII case folding and NUL truncation. This private search predicate is not the literal metadata matching used by composer suggestions.
initialize 58 Create the shared parameter schema and seed stable insertion ordinals from existing SQL row IDs for recovery import; steady-state reads/writes use hub records.
schemas 76 Describe persisted columns, JSON fields and audit-key indexes for hub import/checkpoint serialization, deriving primary-key order from the database schema.
ParameterRecords 96 Maintain derived search and ordered indexes whenever canonical parameter rows change; private search projections remain inside the hub authority.
ParameterRecords.changed 100 Advance admission revision only for configuration changes, maintain insertion/update/type indexes and rebuild private searchable JSON when needed. Usage-only changes do not change accepted-configuration authority.
MemoryParameterStore 155 Implement Parameter Store operations over the Controller hub with atomic record/audit updates and detached API models. Reuse backend-independent defaults, ranking and inspection helpers from the standalone store.
MemoryParameterStore.get_exact 230 Return a detached record for the normalized canonical key only; aliases do not authorize reference acceptance.
MemoryParameterStore.authority_revision 235 Return canonical identity plus creation/update timestamps without exporting values; an optional leading @ is removed before exact lookup.
MemoryParameterStore.get 245 Expose legacy canonical-or-alias lookup as a detached model, returning None for an absent record.
MemoryParameterStore.list 251 Walk newest-update pages until the requested bounded count is filled, matching private values/context as well as metadata with legacy SQL wildcard semantics. Returned records still require consumer projection.
MemoryParameterStore.search_mentions 280 Walk ordered metadata until enough matches are found, without a source cutoff.
MemoryParameterStore.list_profile_types 311 Read every exact indexed profile-type candidate in canonical-key order; account ambiguity must not depend on the UI list limit.
MemoryParameterStore.create 334 Validate typed content and canonical nonreserved identity, normalize metadata and atomically create the row plus projected audit. Dependency revisions and duplicate identities reject the entire transaction.
MemoryParameterStore.update 400 Validate explicit replacement content, apply supplied non-null fields atomically and preserve insertion order on rename. Duplicate/reserved destinations fail; after commit, invalidate the old identity’s sessions.
MemoryParameterStore.compare_update_value 471 Rotate validated profile values only while the target and every dependency revision still match. Return None for a stale comparison; successful updates and revision-only audit evidence commit atomically.
MemoryParameterStore.delete 501 Atomically remove the matching row and record field-name audit evidence, then invalidate its active connection/Auth state. Missing records return False.
MemoryParameterStore.audit_events 535 Return detached events for the normalized key, ordered by timestamp then event ID. Events under an old key remain associated with that key after a rename.
MemoryParameterStore.reveal 551 Return the complete current record only after atomically recording explicit reveal access; authentication/authorization belongs to the caller.
MemoryParameterStore.record_use_in 575 Within an existing transaction, update live counters without changing configuration revisions and audit captured field/env names. prompt_reference actors deduplicate persisted events; returned copies are convenience increments, not reread authoritative counters.
MemoryParameterStore.record_use 612 Wrap nonempty usage accounting in a hub transaction; the empty input performs no mutation.
repository 622 Reuse the hub’s single parameter repository for its canonical recovery path; reject a second path instead of silently sharing unrelated authority.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define strict Parameter Store record, create/update, audit, summary and editable-draft shapes shared by storage, routes and model drafting. Field validators distinguish replacement Value JSON from optional Context JSON, while the store owns typed-profile and canonical-key checks. Summary fields carry already prepared consumer copies; model validation alone neither redacts nor encrypts them. Draft requests reject public model-route overrides and perform no inference or persistence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
AgentParameterRecord 22 One durable key/value parameter entry.
AgentParameterCreate 41 Payload for creating a parameter entry.
AgentParameterCreate.value_must_be_object 58 Reject an explicitly supplied empty or non-object Value JSON. Typed profile validation and canonical/reserved-key checks occur later in the store.
AgentParameterCreate.context_must_be_object 67 Require supplied Context JSON to be an object; an empty object is allowed and store writes can supply the canonical empty domain-context structure.
AgentParameterUpdate 75 Partial update payload for one parameter entry.
AgentParameterUpdate.value_update_must_be_object 92 Permit null to preserve the current value, but require any replacement to be a nonempty object; omitted fields are distinguished by exclude_unset at the store boundary.
AgentParameterUpdate.context_update_must_be_object 101 Permit absent/null context and empty object replacement while rejecting non-object context; this validator does not merge context fields.
AgentParameterAuditEvent 109 One immutable parameter audit event.
AgentParameterSummary 126 Carry the consumer projection and identity metadata. Despite the historical masked field names, this schema performs no redaction: store/auth projection helpers and the active PARAMETERS policy determine which values are visible.
AgentParameterDraftRequest 151 Request to draft one parameter store operation from a prompt.
AgentParameterDraftRequest.controller_models 162 Reject caller-supplied model routing overrides before validating a draft request; the Controller owns the configured inference route.
AgentParameterDraft 172 LLM-authored editable parameter draft.
AgentParameterDraftResponse 190 Response envelope for parameter extraction.
AgentParameterMatch 201 One retrieved parameter and scoring diagnostics.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/private_bindings.py

Python · Tier A

Recover the former opaque parameter-binding format through a locked process-local cache and an exact-revision store fallback. Missing old values fail instead of silently taking an edited record. Current reference acceptance stores ordinary literal records directly and protected Auth identities separately; these compatibility helpers do not provide a durable vault or create current snapshots.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
capture 32 @brief Keep a detached legacy binding under a random process-local handle protected by the module lock. Current reference acceptance persists literal records instead of creating these handles.
resolve 42 @brief Recover a legacy handle from the private cache, or from an exact current-store record only when its timestamp matches the captured revision. Missing historical values raise; a handle-free binding is simply copied.
forget 63 @brief Discard a legacy process-local handle under the cache lock; unknown handles are harmless and no persisted parameter is deleted.
clear_workspace 68 Retire volatile legacy credentials after the owning workspace has drained.

src/agent_runtime/parameters/references.py

Python · Tier A

Parse literal-aware canonical @ references and capture their accepted values/mode once for task admission and resume. Ordinary records remain literal; Auth-protected profiles contribute safe identities. Enforce the full expansion and manifest budgets before inference, retain unresolved names for held-task recovery and defer usage accounting when requested. Model- facing PARAMETERS projection is detached, and aliases/fuzzy discovery never replace exact acceptance.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ParameterReferenceError 43 Safe deterministic rejection before inference.
check_expansion 53 Enforce the aggregate allowance while retaining value-free size evidence.
parse_references 66 @brief Parse and normalize candidate @parameter references while respecting reserved mentions and literal text, preserving deterministic reference order.
matches_mention_metadata 80 Match literal metadata substrings without consulting parameter values.
mention_metadata 88 @brief Expose bounded parameter identity metadata for composer suggestions without returning stored values.
resolve_references 109 @brief Resolve exact selected records at acceptance, preserving ordinary literal snapshots and safe Auth identities. Reuse prior accepted values/mode, enforce raw and manifest limits, and report unknown names without alias selection, new private handles or prompt rewriting.
parameter_context 268 Read accepted raw values; optionally project the model consumer's copy.
pending 318 Report unresolved canonical names or a saved resolution error so admission can hold the task before inference.
